source: can you make me a slip and slide game were the longer you slide the more points you get and you can buy pets to help you speed multiplier and there a treadmills to train your speed and make it 1m studs is the end of the track then you go back to the start of the slip and slide and get 1 lap on your character that is on the top of the screen to show your progress and make furthest stud leader board,most money leader board and most playtime leader board with a popular thumbnail of a bacon sliding on a slip in slide covered in soap with rainbow text saying 999m studs

answers.ask: Is one million studs literal? At walk speed that is over seventeen hours of track - should it be a repeating segment instead?
answers.answer: Make it a repeating segmented track with progress measured up to 1,000,000 studs, so it stays playable while still showing the 1m-stud goal.

answers.ask: What does the slide sit in - a water park, a grass field, a neon void?
answers.answer: Set the slip and slide in a bright cartoon water park with grass around it, soap, and colorful rainbow visuals.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: Is one million studs literal? At walk speed that is over seventeen hours of track - should it be a repeating segment instead? A: Make it a repeating segmented track with progress measured up to 1,000,000 studs, so it stays playable while still showing the 1m-stud goal.
- [author] theme — Q: What does the slide sit in - a water park, a grass field, a neon void? A: Set the slip and slide in a bright cartoon water park with grass around it, soap, and colorful rainbow visuals.
- [agent_inferred] track steering — Q: Is the slide divided into fixed lanes or freely steerable across its width? A: Use one broad freely steerable slide because the prompt does not request lane snapping or competition lanes.

## Enriched image prompt
Build a bright cartoon water-park slip-and-slide as a broad, freely steerable track assembled from repeating deterministic segments. Surround the slide with cheerful grass, soap foam, and colourful rainbow decorations, while keeping every segment's entrance and exit aligned so the apparent run can measure progress up to 1,000,000 studs without constructing a literal million-stud map. Mark distance progress visibly along the slide and place a clear terminal area representing 1,000,000 studs, followed by a return portal to the start. Near the start, include treadmill training stations and exactly three prominent leaderboard walls for furthest distance, most money, and most playtime.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation because training speed, earning points, pet multipliers, and persistent progression drive the game. Infinite Runner is secondary because the slide is emitted as a repeating forward track.

## Shape and preset
Use `lane-free`, Lane (Free Lateral Steering), taken from Infinite Runner's shared shape set: movement continues forward across one broad slide without fixed lane slots. Preset is none because neither Stat Grinder nor Free Runner preserves the combined treadmill-training and non-obstacle sliding loop without substantial changes.

## Config requirements
Use `chunk-modular` for repeating slide segments with matching pivots, `marker-distance` for environmental progress markings, `station-training` in both streams for treadmills near the start, `trigger-finish` in both streams for the terminal 1,000,000-stud marker, `teleporter-link` in both streams for an internal-map return portal, and `tracker-leaderboard` in both streams for the three named boards.

## Layout requirements
Place treadmill `station-training` TriggerZones in the start area. Place one `trigger-finish` TriggerZone at the represented 1,000,000-stud endpoint, one `trigger-lap` detection region there to award the lap, and a paired `teleporter-link` back to the start. Place three leaderboard Trackers together near the start. Pets, points, UI progress, and promotional thumbnail art are not map placements.

## Layout components
One compact water-park set contains a start plaza, treadmill area, three leaderboard walls, a queue of repeating soapy slide chunks through grass and rainbow scenery, distance markers, a terminal finish zone, and a return portal. The physical queue stays compact while representing the full progress distance.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: chunk pivots, slide continuity, finish detection, and the return loop must be planned before colourful dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use medium scale because repeating chunks keep the physical map compact while individual training and finish features remain legible. The theme is bright cartoon water park with grass, soap, and rainbows. `P6` is required so modular track segments connect without drift.
